to: the clients that have the entity, plus the clients in the instance that can see it (`remove_entity_emit`). The `outside` and `not_there` forms go to one socket; `left` goes to the instance

payload.type: DisappearOutside | DisappearTransport | DisappearMagiport | DisappearInvis | DisappearReason | DisappearNotThere | DisappearRemoval | DisappearBare

confirm.note: Every emit of `disappear` is listed in `senders`; each variant cites the lines that build its object. `remove_entity_emit` sends the object unchanged

variants.name: Outside
variants.when: The entity left the vision box of the receiver, died or became invisible. Also before each `type: "all"` `entities` frame, for each entity that is not in the new frame.

variants.name: Transport
variants.when: A character or an NPC moved to another place (`transport_player_to`, `transport_npc_to`).

variants.name: Magiport
variants.when: A monster moved to another place (`transport_monster_to`): a monster skill, an event monster or a cave actor.

variants.name: Disconnect or left
variants.when: `"disconnect"`: a character disconnected. `"left"`: an event NPC (the anniversary baker) left; the server sends it to every player in the instance (`instance_emit`).

variants.name: Not there
variants.when: The target of a `skill` (or `attack`, `heal`) does not exist, is invisible or is too far. Only to your socket, instead of a `game_response`.

variants.name: Removal
variants.when: `remove_monster` with `method: "disappear"` (an event monster expired, a summoned monster, an irregular monster that the server moves) or with `silent` (the instance closed). Same fields as `death`.

variants.name: Bare
variants.when: A pet that `whistle` calls, or an event monster (Slenderman, the tiger) that the server moves to another map. No `reason`.

DisappearOutside.summary: `disappear`: the entity is out of view of this receiver.

fields.name: id
fields.description: The entity id: a monster id or a character name.

fields.name: outside
fields.description: The entity can still exist. The receiver does not see it now.

DisappearTransport.summary: `disappear`: a character or an NPC moved to another place.

fields.name: id
fields.description: The character. An NPC id starts with `$`.

fields.name: to
fields.description: Characters only: the destination instance. Absent when the character is invisible or stealthed, or when the destination is not a normal map (a private instance).

fields.name: s
fields.description: Characters only, with `to`: the spawn index on the destination map, or the `[x, y]` (or `[x, y, direction, scatter]`) point. Absent when the code gives no spawn (node/server.js:4653-4656).

fields.name: effect
fields.description: The effect to draw. A character has it only when there is an effect: `1` (town, respawn, cave doors), `"blink"` or `"magiport"`. An NPC always has `1` or `0`.

DisappearMagiport.summary: `disappear`: a monster moved to another place.

DisappearReason.summary: `disappear`: a character disconnected, or an event NPC left.

fields.name: id
fields.description: The character or the NPC (its id starts with `$`).

DisappearNotThere.summary: `disappear`: the target of a skill is not there.

fields.name: id
fields.description: The `id` of the request, unchanged: a number if the request sent a number.

fields.name: reason
fields.description: The target does not exist, is invisible or is farther than `B.max_vision`.

DisappearRemoval.summary: `disappear`: `remove_monster` removed a monster without a death.

fields.name: luckm
fields.description: The luck multiplier of the character that the monster targeted, or 1.

fields.name: points
fields.description: Only for a cooperative monster: the contribution points, keyed by character name.

DisappearBare.summary: `disappear` with only the id: a pet or an event monster moved.

senders.what: The tick of the instance (`send_xy_updates`): an entity left the view of the receiver
`send_all_xy` (`send_updates`, `loaded`, `new_map`, `start`): entities that are not in the new frame
`transport_player_to`: `transport`, `town`, `enter`, `leave`, `respawn`, `join`, `duel`, the `magiport` and `blink` skills, jail, cave doors, bank entry and exit
`transport_npc_to`: an NPC moved to another instance
The `skill` handler: the target is not there
The `whistle` handler: the pet moves to you
The event loop: an event NPC left
The event loop: Slenderman or the tiger moved to another map
